subtype.name: choose the next measurement under a budget (EQE and XRD), realized value of the best measured composition

grader.kind: replayable environment: full measured EQE map per episode (CaltechDATA 42gwd-8wg77), revealed per query
grader.certification_stage: I4/I5 (runtime/mcp/server.py measure_eqe returns the recorded value; known-input and negative controls)

yield_per_unit.arithmetic: one graded realized value per episode = max measured EQE / max EQE on the line in [0,1]; 5 per-round values recorded as secondary

role_floor.role: simulator (the environment answers an action the agent chose); FM tools act as scorer on agent-built hypotheses (substitute_structure -> mace_stability / megnet_bandgap)

alternatives_considered.note: predicting the best composition (pick 1 of M) sits on the predictor line; the seeds' action is committing measurements (S1 commits PEC/stability to 5 phases; S2, S3 one measurement per iteration), so the realized value, not the prediction, is the governed decision
phase-identity labels are analyst XRD annotation in Bruker EVA (S1 methods), and the mpid mapping is a post-hoc nearest-structure mapping; no certified judge; answers also sit in S1 Fig. 3
no oracle predicts EQE for a designed composition or structure; MEGNet gap is not EQE (I4)

item_template.description: one M-Sb-O composition line, conditions (substrate, anneal T, pH, photon energy), ~29 candidates by Sb fraction; 5 EQE + 5 XRD measurements; submit best measured index with rejections

branch_census.chain_length: S1 ~12 steps (deposit, anneal, XRF, XRD, PEC at 4 LEDs x 3 pH, phase ID, down-select, Pourbaix, stability, SEM); S2 ~9; S3 ~6
branch_census.branches_with_named_rejection: S1: excluded phases and substituted MP entries named; S2: SbTe vs Sb2Te2/Sb2Te3 named and settled by electron diffraction
branch_census.branches_per_episode: 10 sequential choices (5 EQE + 5 XRD), so multi-turn

depth_census.measured_depth: measured at I2 by leave-one-out over the fixed compositions: EQE-only (cls_gp) vs +XRD (cls_xrd) vs +FM (fm_xrd, fm_prior); see instrument/i2_channels.json
depth_census.supply_at_this_depth: all 189 included episodes carry XRD and EQE at every point
unmounted_channels: optical absorption (not in deposit for 22 plates)
